matches.summary: Jacob Fatu wins by disqualification over Cody Rhodes, Bron Breakker in a Ladder Match and wins the Power Pro Wrestling Men's Championship
Jey Uso & Jimmy Uso wins after a distraction over Chad Gable & El Grande Americano and retains the Power Pro Wrestling Tag Team Championship
Naomi wins by count-out over Lyra Valkyria and retains the Power Pro Wrestling Women's Championship
Cody Rhodes wins by submission over Jacob Fatu in a Submission Match and retains the Power Pro Wrestling Men's Championship
